method: Proposes a novel method for phonetic retrieval in the CueVideo system based on probabilistic term weighting using phone confusion data in a Bayesian framework to improve spoken document retrieval.
key_assumptions: Phone confusion data can be used to improve term weighting for spoken document retrieval.
main_contribution: Introduces phonetic retrieval method that improves recall for out-of-vocabulary words and balances recall/precision for in-vocabulary words.
results: ["Achieved average recall of 0.88 and average precision of 0.69 for out-of-vocabulary words; 17% improvement in recall over word-based retrieval for in-vocabulary words."]

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: Focuses on phonetic retrieval for spoken documents, unrelated to temporal versioning or regulatory QA.
